_comment: Rates are USD per million tokens. Public list price per Anthropic's official pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), fetched 2026-10-13. VERIFY against your actual contract/negotiated rates before trusting dollar totals for a budget decision — this file is a starting point, not a guarantee. Keyed by the exact `model` string Claude Code writes into its own session transcripts, which can differ from the user-facing model names (e.g. transcripts record "claude-sonnet-5", confirmed by inspection, not the public "Claude Sonnet 5.5" name).
